verdict.rationale: Bolna documents an extraction-categories API to define custom structured fields per agent, an analytics tab that lets you 'Configure webhooks, call summaries, and extractions... Push data to your CRM from every call,' and a call-summary toggle plus call-history view exposing transcripts, recordings, and raw execution data. Together these cover outcome/entity/disposition extraction delivered via API or webhook as the story describes. Missing for 10: a concrete example of the extraction/webhook JSON payload showing entities/dispositions, and independent (non-vendor) confirmation that this works in production.
